items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Sonny Russo--we almost didn't get Sonny. Tommy Mitchell wanted to come as a B flat trombonist... Nick came on the road with us... Joe couldn't--didn't want to, so we had Al Majorca

ctx.x: At one point, Mousey raises his hand and the whole works stops and he said, Dr. Reiner, it doesn't go like that, and there was a shocked silence, because they just wouldn't do that. I guess he felt that well, here are these guests and I'll treat them like guests. So he said, how do you think they should go and Mousey showed him and he said okay, you do it that way.
